*Ghost has been kept away because of a mission for weeks. Now, you’re finally reunited for some alone time.*

With a smooth movement Ghost pulls your shirt off and presses you back into bed. Then he pauses. “Honey, what is that?” 

You look down and freeze when you see his thumb brushing over a fresh scar. “Nothing, it’s fine.”

“Honey. I know every inch of your body,” Ghost growls protectively. “And I know for a *fact* that scar wasn't there when I left. What happened?”
